prohibited: automatic activation of Australian clinical rules
automatic use of Australian jurisdictional identifiers, Medicare rules, PBS rules or AMT codes in Korean deployment
claiming AU Core conformance without profile validation
importing source-defined questionnaires as dynamic interview knowledge

computable_rule_projection.cds_hooks: External workflow adapter only; never the internal rule language or Runtime decision source.
computable_rule_projection.cql_elm: Optional primary standards projection for expressions after review and engine conformance testing.
computable_rule_projection.fhir_activity_definition: Optional atomic activity definition; interview packages cannot generate clinical orders.
computable_rule_projection.fhir_library: Optional container for reviewed CQL/ELM and dependencies.
computable_rule_projection.fhir_plan_definition: Optional exchange and orchestration projection; it does not prove an action was ordered or performed.
computable_rule_projection.gdl2: Secondary research cross-validation projection only because the specification is trial-use and no repository engine conformance has been established.

fixed_questionnaires.rule: Source-defined fixed questionnaires remain excluded unless explicitly requested and verified against an authoritative original.

openehr_content.archetype_role: Reusable clinical model and data-quality cross-check at Build Time.
openehr_content.local_codes: openEHR at-codes and ac-codes are local model identifiers and must not be represented as LOINC or SNOMED CT mappings.
openehr_content.opt_role: Flattened compiled-model pattern; not a Runtime dependency.
openehr_content.template_role: Use-case assembly and required-field classification reference at Build Time.

purpose: Use Australian FHIR, openEHR and HL7 clinical-reasoning artifacts as Build-Time structure, mapping and cross-validation references without transferring foreign jurisdiction or executable clinical authority into the Korean Clinical Interview Runtime.
